title: AC1027 VIEWPORT LTYPE XDATA targets in ENTITIES and named BLOCKS

scope.source: Runtime-generated original ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One VIEWPORT code-1005 target in model-space ENTITIES and one in named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS across all four source/output encoding pairs per section.

xdata.provider: source-bound simple LTYPE EditDash and APPID MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA

proof.source: Candidate binding requires matching the physical VIEWPORT span and owner, the actual addViewport parser event, exact DRW_Viewport dynamic type, unique live handle and (for BLOCKS) complete structural membership proof with the selected Primary role and block-record owner.
proof.output: All eight ASCII/binary input/output and section combinations verify remapped VIEWPORT identity, section, owner and block membership; selected physical viewport extents, status/id, center, direction, target and height; ordered LTYPE code-1005 remapping; and fresh typed VIEWPORT/LTYPE readback.
proof.failure_retry: Each of the eight success combinations removes the target and verifies destination preservation followed by same-adapter retry. Separate late-handle mutation controls refuse with destination preservation and succeed after restoring target identity for each section.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 VIEWPORT profile in each of ENTITIES and a named BLOCKS record. Other viewport fields/versions, paper-space LAYOUT association, viewport handle dependencies and mixed target sets remain unqualified.
The named-block source is a transport profile. It does not establish native viewport placement, rendering, a complete layout graph or independent CAD semantics.
P2 remains open for other code-1005 target types, mixed target sets and broader source/output profiles.
next: Select the next P2 target only after reproducing a concrete code-1005 parser, source-binding or emitted-output gap; avoid expanding viewport scope beyond the fields and owners independently bound here.
